'''Tovi Brill''' was a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] who raised [[laca]] herds on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makthierse]] with his brother, [[Sirloss Brill|Sirloss]]. Initially they set up in the [[Quantrax Creek]] region, but the herd was preyed on by [[preying makthier]]s. Tovi was attacked and stung by one of the creatures, and was knocked out. When he came to, he had a terrible headache. Brill and his brother subsequently moved the herd north.<ref name="COG" />
